messages:
Talia: quick q — we're updating SIEM export policy. Proposal: exported slices to partners must have PII masked and long-term archive encrypted with a customer-managed KMS (customer CMK). We also want a new RBAC role for forensics access (forensics.viewer) that can request JIT unmasking for incident triage. Thoughts? @oncall

Aj: +1 on CMK. Practical suggestion: keep searchable SIEM retention short (90 days) and archive encrypted exports for 7 years. forensics.viewer should be read-only by default; JIT unmasking requires 2 approvers and an audit-bot entry. Recommend an OPA policy like: allow only metadata queries unless role == forensics.viewer and ticket approved.

Maria: do we have a ticket for this? need GDPR parity — EU exports must stay in EU region and use EU CMK. Also who are the approvers? Legal + Sec + DataOwner? :thinking_face:

Devon: prefer exporting masked payloads by default. Offer a metadata-only export for partners. If unmask needed for forensics, create an ephemeral snapshot that we decrypt server-side via a key-access-proxy (no plaintext blobs in partner buckets). That avoids long-lived decrypted copies.

audit-bot: SEC-421 created by Talia — "siem: partner export masking + cmk + forensics role". Required approvals: security_review, legal_signoff, data_owner. Workflow: create ticket comment with justification, link to incident if applicable.

Aj: here's a minimal export config snippet for infra CI linting: 
```
export:
  destination: s3://partner-exports/prod/
  mask_policy: pii-redact
  archive_kms_key: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/siem/cryptoKeys/partner-archive
  retention_days: 90
```
I'll add an OPA rule to enforce mask_policy unless a scoped role and approved ticket are attached.

Maria: +1 on EU bucket requirement. Make sure we tag exports with region and purpose so legal can filter. Add 'data_protection' to approvers list.

Ops-lead: runbook updates: when JIT unmask requested, page oncall, require ticket id and justification, and start a 30-minute access window that is logged. Also add a CI job to rotate export credentials monthly and flag any export config that points to external buckets without CMK.

Talia: ok — I'll update SEC-421 checklist: approvers = SecurityLead, Legal, DataOwner (+ DataProtection for EU cases). I'll draft the OPA policy PR and link runbook changes. Can someone pair with Devon to design the key-unwrapping proxy (no plaintext in storage)? @Devon @Aj

Devon: happy to pair, ping me 14:00 PT.

Aj: I'll push the initial OPA rule and add an infra-ci lint to reject exports without mask_policy or CMK.

Talia: thanks all :thumbsup: I'll add notes to the incident playbook and update the partner onboarding checklist. We should revisit retention numbers in Q3 after usage analysis.
